title: Oxford Turkey Trot takes canned goods Tuesday afternoon and again Thanksgiving morning
excerpt: The Ole Miss trail walk is free. Ten cans earn a T-shirt while supplies last, and donations go to Grove Grocery and the Oxford Food Pantry.
locality: Nearby Thanksgiving event in Oxford, Mississippi, for Pontotoc County readers traveling to Lafayette County.

paragraphs.text: Tuesday afternoon is the last advance drop-off for people bringing canned goods to the University of Mississippi’s Thanksgiving Turkey Trot in Oxford. Donors can take 10 cans to the South Campus Recreation Center lobby from 3:45 to 6:15 p.m. Nov. 24 and pick up an event T-shirt while supplies last.

The run and walk is free, and participants choose their own distance on the South Campus Rail Trail. The event runs from 8:30 to 10:30 a.m. Thursday, Nov. 26, at 980 Whirlpool Drive. Anyone who misses the Tuesday drop-off can bring cans to the trailhead at 8:30 Thursday morning. Coffee and light refreshments will be available there.

The food goes to Grove Grocery and the Oxford Food Pantry. Grove Grocery serves the university community from Kinard Hall on Rebel Drive. For accessibility arrangements for the walk, Ole Miss Campus Recreation lists 662-915-4079 and campusrec@olemiss.edu.
